title: Reverse an Array
description: Given `N` and `N` integers, print the array in reverse order separated by spaces.
instructions: Reverse the array (using two pointers or reverse traversal) and print elements separated by spaces.
hints: Two-pointer approach: swap `arr[left]` and `arr[right]` while `left < right`.
Or iterate from `n - 1` down to `0` and join with spaces.
Make sure output is space-separated on one line.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Reverse and print space-separated
